annotations.title: The next episode of a series

description: A series' setup (kind, look, voice, length, tone, music), its taste, every episode with which are made, and the episode to make now (the next one not made, or the number asked). Call it when they ask for the next (or a given) episode of a series, then make that episode with the setup as it is (don't ask the first question or show pickers again: the series settles them), passing series and episode to start_video or start_story.

episode.description: A given episode; else the next one not made

name: next_episode
